# **Privacy Policy for Internal Links SEOwind Chrome Plugin**

**Introduction**

This privacy policy describes how SEOwind (“we,” “us,” or “our”) collects, uses, and discloses your information in connection with your use of our Chrome extension, “Internal Links SEOwind” (“Extension”).

**Information We Collect**

- **Website Data:** When you use the Extension on a webpage, we may analyze anonymized website content (excluding personal information) to suggest internal linking opportunities.
- **Google Search Console Data:** With your permission, the Extension can access data from your Google Search Console account to understand your website’s performance and identify relevant internal linking opportunities. This data may include website traffic information and keyword performance.
- **User-Generated Data:** The Extension may store suggestions you generate for internal linking opportunities..

**How We Use Your Information**

We use the information we collect for the following purposes:

- To provide, maintain, and improve the Extension’s functionality, particularly suggesting relevant internal linking opportunities.
- To analyze anonymized website content to identify potential linking opportunities.
- To store user-generated internal linking suggestions for improved workflow efficiency.
- To link your Google Search Console data (with your permission) to analyze your website’s performance and suggest relevant internal links.

**Information Sharing and Disclosure**

We do not share or sell your personal information to third parties. We may share website data (excluding personal information) with our servers to analyze website content for suggesting internal links. Additionally, we may use anonymized and aggregated data to create reports that help us understand overall performance trends and the impact of internal linking on website growth. These reports will not contain any personally identifiable information and are solely intended to enhance our service and provide insights into general usage patterns.

**Data Security**

We take reasonable steps to protect your information from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. However, no internet transmission or electronic storage method is completely secure.

**Your Choices**

- You can manage your Google Search Console data access permissions through your Google account settings.
- You can uninstall the Extension at any time to discontinue our collection of any further information.

**Contact Us**

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at hello@seowind.io.

**Updates to this Privacy Policy**

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page.

This Privacy Policy is intended to be clear and concise. If you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to contact us.

**Effective Date:** 25 April 2024

© 2026 SEOwind.
